import json,os,re,subprocess,stat
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects')
projs=('pink','fadego','iptv','telegram','lowcost','rea','ferrari','codex','project','hopper')
locations=('/home/ubuntu','/opt','/srv','/var/lib','/var/www','/usr/local/bin','/usr/local/sbin','/etc')
out={'audit':'external-project-candidates-small','roots':[],'locations':{},'running':{},'links':[]}
out['roots']=sorted(p.name for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink())
for base in locations:
 p=Path(base)
 if not p.is_dir():continue
 entries=[]
 for x in p.iterdir():
  name=x.name
  if base=='/srv' and name=='projects':continue
  if base=='/etc' and not any(w in name.lower() for w in projs):continue
  if base not in ('/srv','/home/ubuntu','/opt') and not any(w in name.lower() for w in projs):continue
  if base=='/home/ubuntu' and not any(w in name.lower() for w in projs):continue
  try:
   s=x.lstat()
   entries.append([name,'link' if x.is_symlink() else 'dir' if x.is_dir() else 'file' if x.is_file() else 'other',s.st_size if x.is_file() else 0])
  except OSError:pass
 out['locations'][base]=entries[:65]
for service in ('fadego-staging','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads','ssh','nginx','postgresql@16-main'):
 t=subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active',service],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=7)
 out['running'][service]=t.stdout.strip()
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
